name: beth
description: Beth — AI Kitchen Concierge for 360 Cookware (Shopify Plus)

scripts.db:migrate: npm run prisma -w beth-app -- migrate deploy
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run build:core && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck -w beth-app
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w beth-app
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w beth-app
